questions.response: draw on the figure and write an answer
questions.prompt: Graph f(x) = |x - 2| - 3. Give the vertex and the x-intercepts.
questions.prompt_markup:
Graph f(x) = |x - 2| - 3.
Give the vertex and the x-intercepts.
questions.drawing_answer: A V-shape opening up with vertex (2, -3), through (-1, 0), (0, -1), (4, -1), and (5, 0)
questions.grading_note: Form required: the vertex and both intercepts. Both the graph and the answer are graded. |x - 2| = 3 gives x = 5 or x = -1.
